name: Camping 101: Skinning

angles.text: As a Horde skinner in Mulgore, you can visit Bloodhoof Village and learn to make camp gear from the hides you gather.
As a tauren skinner, you can learn from Yonn Deepcut in the heart of Mulgore to make chairs from beast hides for wilderness rest.
As a cook, you can learn from culinary trainers to make a campfire for your camp.

faq.answer: In Mulgore, Yonn Deepcut teaches skinners to make a Camp Chair in Bloodhoof Village. First, they show they can harvest beast hides.

aliases: who to talk to for camping skinning
faq.answer: Yonn Deepcut teaches skinners to make a Camp Chair in Bloodhoof Village, Mulgore, after they demonstrate skill at harvesting beast hides.
faq.q: Who teaches the Camp Chair recipe?

aliases: what does a camp chair do
faq.answer: A Camp Chair gives you a comfortable place to rest when you camp in the wild. Sitting helps you recover strength and stay ready for battle.
faq.q: What is a Camp Chair used for?

aliases: where can i make a camp
faq.answer: Set up camp in the wilderness. Townspeople do not welcome travelers pitching tents in settlements.
faq.q: Where can you set up a camp?

aliases: what else do i need for camp
do i need a fire to camp
faq.answer: A camp also needs a campfire. Local cooks and culinary trainers teach you how to make one.
faq.q: What else is required to set up a camp?

faq.answer: Bloodhoof Village lies in Mulgore. The tauren settlement is home to tradespeople, including skinning trainers.

sections.body: Fallen beasts yield hides and pelts that skinners can turn into useful gear. Leather becomes armor, and animal skins can also make comforts for the wild. After long weeks crossing untamed lands, travelers can rest on gear made from those hides and stay sharp in combat.
sections.title: Hides of the Wild

sections.body: In Mulgore, skinners visit Bloodhoof Village to speak with Yonn Deepcut. Once they show they can harvest beast hides, Yonn teaches them to stitch together a Camp Chair. Towns and villages do not welcome travelers pitching tents in their streets, so the chairs are for wilderness use. A campfire completes the camp, and local cooks teach how to make one.
sections.title: Lessons in Bloodhoof Village

summary: In Mulgore, skinners learn to make a Camp Chair for wilderness rest. Yonn Deepcut teaches the craft in Bloodhoof Village, where skilled hide-gatherers prepare for camps beyond the settlements.
